intro.bubble: Hello! I'm the ZekoulABia setup assistant. With a few questions, I'll fully configure {schoolName} — classes, subjects, calendar, fees — automatically. Shall we?
intro.reconciled: Good news: I've already loaded what you provided at registration (cycles, levels, series, LV2…). We just need to finish a few settings.

cycles.title: Let's start with your school's structure. Which cycles do you teach?
cycles.secondCycle: Second cycle secondary (2nde → Tle / Lower → Upper Sixth)

template.bubble:
Based on your answers, your school matches: {template}.
We will automatically configure classes, subjects with official MINESEC coefficients, departments, and the calendar. Is this correct ?
template.later: Continue anyway (I'll refine later with the assistant)

series.title: Which series do you offer in second cycle? (Check all that apply)
series.note: Series D and TI are not available in 2nde (MINESEC regulations).

enCombos.error: Unable to load combinations, please retry.
enCombos.info: In the Anglophone system, each subject is assessed independently. Combinations serve as guidance: students can customize their choices (max 5 subjects at A-Level).

technical.title: Which technical fields do you offer?

primaryLevels.title: Which primary levels do you have?

lv2.activeTitle: Does your school offer a second modern language (LV2)?
lv2.languagesTitle: Which languages are taught as LV2?
lv2.orgTitle: How is LV2 organized in your classes? (Multiple choices possible)
lv2.perLevelTitle: Let's specify by level. For each level, indicate the organization (and the language if the whole class does the same).
lv2.perClassTitle: For each class, choose its LV2 language. If several languages coexist in the same class, click « Mixed ».
lv2.uniforme: An entire class does the same language (e.g. Form 4A = all German)
lv2.mixte: Within the same class, students are split by language
lv2.variable: It varies by level or class
lv2.uniformeScopeTitle: Is it the same language across the whole school, or can it vary from class to class?
lv2.uniformeScopeGlobal: Same language everywhere (one language for the whole school)
lv2.uniformeScopePerClass: Each class can have its own language
lv2.uniformeGlobalTitle: Which language is used across the whole school?
lv2.uniformeClass: The whole class does the same language
